fullPassage: In 2025, a team of researchers at the MIT Media Lab conducted an experiment that swiftly captured international attention. Volunteers were divided into three groups and instructed to write essays under different conditions: one group used ChatGPT, another relied on a conventional search engine, and the third wrote entirely unaided. While the participants composed their essays, the researchers monitored their brain activity using electroencephalography (EEG). The results were striking: the group that used ChatGPT exhibited markedly weaker neural connectivity than the other two, and their essays were judged by human evaluators to be less original. More surprisingly still, when these same participants were later asked to write without any AI assistance, their brain activity remained noticeably subdued compared to that of participants who had never used AI in the first place. The researchers termed this phenomenon "cognitive debt"—a short-term gain in efficiency that may come at the expense of long-term independent thinking. Although the study remains preliminary, it has already prompted many educators to reconsider how AI ought to be integrated into the classroom.

questions.passage: In 2025, a team of researchers at the MIT Media Lab conducted an experiment that swiftly captured international attention. Volunteers were divided into three groups and instructed to write essays under different conditions: one group used ChatGPT, another relied on a conventional search engine, and the third wrote entirely unaided. While the participants composed their essays, the researchers monitored their brain activity using electroencephalography (EEG). The results were striking: the group that used ChatGPT exhibited markedly weaker neural connectivity than the other two, and their essays were judged by human evaluators to be less original. More surprisingly still, when these same participants were later asked to write without any AI assistance, their brain activity remained noticeably subdued compared to that of participants who had never used AI in the first place. The researchers termed this phenomenon "cognitive debt"—a short-term gain in efficiency that may come at the expense of long-term independent thinking. Although the study remains preliminary, it has already prompted many educators to reconsider how AI ought to be integrated into the classroom.

❌ ④ 불일치: ChatGPT 집단은 '더 약한' 신경 연결성을 보였으므로 '더 강한'은 반대
det.tip: AI 없이 다시 써도 remained subdued(여전히 위축). 나머지는 본문과 반대

ch: AI 도움 없이 다시 글을 쓰게 했을 때에도 ChatGPT 사용 집단의 뇌 활동은 여전히 위축돼 있었다.

det.tip: 복수 주어(their essays)에는 복수 be동사 → were judged(O), was judged(X)

det.korean: 단기 효율성의 대가로 희생될 수 있는 것 — 장기적인 독립적 사고

questions.stem: 다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 주제: AI 의존적 글쓰기와 인지 부채(사고력 약화)
det.analysis:

det.korean: 요지: AI 의존은 단기 효율성 대신 장기 사고력을 희생시킬 수 있음

❌ ③ 학습 능력 정확 예측: EEG는 뇌 활동을 관찰했을 뿐 학습 능력 예측을 주장하지 않음

[조건] (1) activity, brain, electroencephalography, monitored, their, using 를 모두 사용

det.korean: monitored their brain activity using electroencephalography
det.analysis:
빈칸 자리: 'the researchers __________ (EEG).'

순서 만들기: 동사 monitored(관찰했다) → 목적어 their brain activity(그들의 뇌 활동을) → 수단의 분사구문 using electroencephalography(뇌전도를 사용하여).

'using ~'은 '~을 사용하여'라는 수단을 나타내는 분사구문으로 목적어 뒤에 붙는다. 따라서 'monitored their brain activity using electroencephalography'가 된다.
